description: Use when the user asks for guidance, comfort, or a teaching on any life situation (fear, failure, duty, grief, anger, stress, decisions, work, relationships, detachment, death, purpose) or asks what the Bhagavad Gita or Krishna says about something. Semantic search over all 700 verses. Write the query in English describing the feeling or situation (e.g. 'anger control', 'fear of failure in exams', 'grief after a parent's death'), even if the user wrote in Hindi or Hinglish. Returns real verses with Sanskrit, transliteration, two translations and the chapter.verse reference. Always cite the reference.

query.description: What the user is going through or asking about, in their own words
